name: Puru Singh
tagline: Software Development Engineer at ASU's AI Cloud Innovation Center (Powered by AWS), building full-stack, AI-powered applications.
bio: I'm Puru Singh, a Computer Science student at Arizona State University (GPA 3.6; Dean's List Fall 2024) and a Software Development Engineer at the ASU AI Cloud Innovation Center, Powered by AWS. I build full-stack, AI-powered applications — shipping cloud prototypes on AWS with Amazon Bedrock and AWS CDK, and production web platforms with React, Angular, and Node.js.
